Why did we choose this venue, and should I reconsider it?
We chose Hotel Marina despite its higher cost because
Hotel Orchid double-booked the 2025 Summit, found ten
days before the event. Jun Wong directed that Orchid never
be used again. You should not reconsider the venue.
